title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Closing a Decided Claim on a Cover
content:
A claim under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` that carries a decision can be closed on its cover by the desk. This operations reference describes the tool that does so.

## Capability

`close_cargo_claim_a3572c28` ends the open state of a decided claim on a cargo cover. It acts on a cover whose open claim already carries a decision, be it an approval or a rejection. A single call sets the cover's status to `claim_closed`. It books no money, leaves every claim file as it stands and pays nothing.

## Invocation

The desk agent unlocks this tool and runs it directly; it is not handed to the customer.

## Parameter

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cover_id` | the cargo cover whose decided claim is to be closed, from the cover lookup | identifier |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "claim_closed", `cover_id` for the cover concerned and `cover_status`, the status the cover shows after the call, which reads `claim_closed`.

## Contract points

- *Does closing pay the settlement?* No. The tool pays nothing and books no amount.
- *Does closing alter the claim file's own record?* No. Only the cover's status changes.
